subject: Offer accepted — background consent + IT seat / start-date coordination for Jordan Price

Subject: Offer accepted — next steps: background consent & start window

Hi Jordan,

Congrats again and welcome — thrilled to have you joining the Edge Infra team. Quick note to outline immediate next steps so we can lock down your Dec start window: 

1) Background check — attached is a short consent form (consent_form_JPrice.pdf). Please sign and reply with that document attached. We use ClearHire for verifications.
2) ID verification — scan/photo of passport or driver's license (redact SSN) — attach to your reply.
3) Start date window — you previously indicated mid-December. Can you confirm a preferred first day between Mon Dec 14 and Fri Dec 18? We’ll target Dec 14 if no preference.
4) IT / seat provisioning — copying Lauren and Monica to reserve hardware and set up seat on Day 0.

Attachments: offer_letter_JPrice_20261126.pdf (offer PDF), consent_form_JPrice.pdf (sign + return).

If you want to chat quickly about logistics, I’m available 10–11 AM PT today.

Thanks,
Priyom
Recruiting Lead — Redwood Inference
Priyom Das | priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0123

Thanks — excited to join. I’ve attached the signed consent (consent_form_JPrice_signed_20261127.pdf) and a redacted photo of my passport (jordan_id_passport_redacted.jpg).
